items.prompt: A candid cinematic still from a contemporary Chinese romantic drama, square frame. Viewed from far away through partially blurred hotel lobby plants, a young Chinese woman in a midnight-blue elegant evening dress stands in a warm marble corridor angrily pointing at a tall Chinese man in a fitted black dinner suit leaning against a cream wall. They are physically separated by an arm's length. Long-lens paparazzi composition, slightly obstructed sightline, compressed perspective, subdued golden wall sconces, realistic hotel architecture. Their faces are not perfectly sharp, the composition feels accidentally captured rather than posed. No captions, no embedded social media interface, no logos.

A cinematic still depicting the exact same hotel corridor argument as a digitally magnified crop of distant paparazzi footage, square frame. A tall handsome Chinese man in his early thirties with neatly styled short black hair and a tailored black dinner suit leans against cream marble, gaze lowered. His eyes flick upward towards the woman just outside frame, restrained and vulnerable rather than aggressive. Warm wall sconce at screen right, blue evening dress slightly visible at left foreground. Telephoto compression, image compression artifacts and a little motion softness consistent with secretly recorded phone video. No text or watermark.

A single decisive moment in the same contemporary Chinese drama hotel corridor, square cinematic frame. A slim Chinese woman with long dark hair wearing the same midnight-blue sleeveless evening dress loses her balance backward after gesturing emphatically. Directly in front of her, the tall Chinese man in the same black dinner suit instinctively leans forward with one arm extended to catch her at the side of her waist. Their faces show surprise and immediate concern; he has not yet embraced her. Medium shot, both subjects entirely within central 70 percent of canvas, warm gold hallway light, realistic fabric movement and anatomy, the same cream marble wall in background. One instantaneous action, not a montage, no text or watermark.
